title: Hell Revealed II
description: Hell Revealed II is a 32-map megawad for Doom II created by a 14-member team led by Jonas Feragen. Designed as a sequel to the original Hell Revealed with mapper Yonatan Donner's approval, it was considered one of the most difficult mapsets at the time of its release.

screenshots.caption: The main menu brought up at the beginning of MAP01: IGNITION!, showing the megawad's custom menu design and status bar.
